summary: First slice of the browser-surface generalization (comms-30 / release-22): moves the generic, product-neutral web policy Alpha's browser applies into plugins/plugin-native-browser-surface as pure-JVM classes. BrowserWebOrigin (canonical http(s) origins, blob: owners, site/subdomain matching), BrowserDownloadPolicy (exact-origin open-tab cookie scope, header-safe cookies, portable file names, native data: decoding within 64 MB, a download list that never persists ephemeral-profile entries, forgets them on tab close and clears per site) and BrowserSitePermissions (camera/microphone/location decisions per exact origin for the persistent profile only, never read or recorded for ephemeral tabs, bounded, revocable per site).

contract.BrowserWebOrigin: of(url) -> 'scheme://host[:port]' lower case, default port elided, http/https only; null for user info, no host, control characters, > 8192 chars or unparsable. blobOwner, sameOrigin (null never matches), host, withinSite(origin, site) = host is site or a dot-subdomain.
contract.BrowserDownloadPolicy: cookieAllowed(download, pageOrigin, sourceTabOpen) only for the exact same origin and an open source tab; cookieHeaderAcceptable bounds and refuses CR/LF; sanitizeName; validMime; dataMime; decodeData (percent-decode, base64 MIME decoder, 64 MB). History: restore drops ephemeral entries, persistable() returns persistent-profile entries only, forgetEphemeralTab, clear, clearSite, MAX_ENTRIES 50.
contract.BrowserSitePermissions: decision/record take an ephemeral flag; ephemeral never reads or writes. KINDS camera, microphone, location; MAX_ORIGINS 200 with oldest-first eviction; restore drops non-canonical origins and unknown kinds; clearSite, clear, snapshot for the host's sealed storage.

hostKeeps: Review and permission UI and wording, OS runtime permission requests, sealed storage, DownloadManager/MediaStore, blob: capture in an isolated script world, HTTP authentication prompts.
applicationModel: Reference only (not materialized into .eliza/patched). Adds new classes and appends a README section; touches no file 0038 or 0060 changes and applies after them in series. Alpha's BrowserDownloads and BrowserSessionStore keep their current equivalent logic until this lands upstream, Gradle includes :eliza-browser-surface from the patched tree (android/settings.gradle, owned by P01) and Alpha switches to these classes.
